caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular mirror with a wooden frame, centered vertically on a plain, light beige background. The frame is dark brown and features a simple border along the sides and bottom, while the top is elaborately curved and ornamental with three prominent upward-facing scrolls. The inside of the mirror is rendered with a very light wash of color, giving the effect of a subtly reflective or blank surface. In the lower right corner of the paper, the name “Rex Dolmith” is handwritten in black ink. There are no additional objects or decorations in the image.
title: Looking-glass
